name: Chiricahua National Park
policyReason: The park page allows leashed pets on the lower canyon trails only.
summary: Leashed pets may use the lower canyon trails, but no trails above 5,500 feet.

excerpts.quote: Pets on leashes are allowed on the lower canyon trails
Pets are not permitted on any trails above 5,500 feet (including Massai Point Nature, Echo Canyon, Heart of the Rocks, Natural Bridge, and Sugarloaf Trails).

dogRules.text: Allowed on Bonita Creek, Faraway Ranch, Silver Spur Meadow and the campground connector trails.
No trails above 5,500 ft, including Echo Canyon and Heart of the Rocks.
Coronado National Forest trails allow pets.
